components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary call-to-action. Used for Create Post, Login, and other main actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #d9dee8; color: #0e1117; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 8px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9dee8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.62; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Used for Logout, Cancel, and alternatives.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: #12141a; color: #f4f5f7; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 8px 24px; border: 1px solid #272a32; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #17191f; border-color: #d9dee8; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d9dee8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status indicator for posts and jobs. Color pair signals state instantly.
components.html: Published Scheduled Failed
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-success { background: rgba(24, 138, 91, 0.16); color: #188a5b; } .ds-badge-pending { background: rgba(47, 125, 191, 0.16); color: #2f7dbf; } .ds-badge-danger { background: rgba(201, 72, 58, 0.16); color: #c9483a; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: App navigation sidebar with active state highlight.
components.html: DashboardPostsJobsAccounts
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #f4f5f7; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #17191f; border-color: #272a32; } .ds-nav-active { background: #1d212a; color: #f4f5f7; border-color: #d9dee8; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Content card. Used for grouping related data on dashboard and list pages.
components.html:
Upcoming Posts

Content inside the card body.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0f1013; border: 1px solid #272a32; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36); } .ds-card-header { padding: 16px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #272a32; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; color: #f4f5f7; margin: 0; } .ds-card-body { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-text { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #a5aab5; margin: 0; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input for forms and filters.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #17191f; color: #f4f5f7; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #272a32; border-radius: 8px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #d9dee8; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #d9dee8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d9dee8; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a5aab5; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table for lists of posts, jobs, and accounts.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #f4f5f7; } .ds-table thead { background: #12141a; } .ds-table th { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: #a5aab5; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #272a32; } .ds-table td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #272a32; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02); } .ds-mono { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview: Meta Lab is a publishing desk for a single operator: a clean, dark surface where content arrives, gets scheduled, and departs. Every element that doesn't carry post metadata is excess. The interface is a terminal-quality GUI — high information density, no decorative flourishes, every pixel earning its place. This system explicitly rejects Generic SaaS Cream: no pastel gradients, round illustration masks, hero-metric templates, or 'modern' dataviz ornament. The aesthetic is editorial and sparse. Think a darkroom crossed with a flight deck: precise controls, meaningful status lights, and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Content-forward: posts, status, and schedules own the interface
Status at a glance: color + shape signals before text
Tonal surfaces layered by lightness (canvas → surface → subtle)
Panel shadow (0 16px 42px) for containers that need to float
Tight typography stack with clear hierarchy

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: The accent primary (brand.300) appears on ≤5% of any surface. Its application is limited to active navigation, focus rings, and border hover states. Never decorative, never repeated.

rules.name: The Status Light Rule
rules.body: Status colors always appear in pairs: a solid text/icon color and a matching background at 16% opacity. The background gives the color presence at small sizes; the pair ensures badges and labels are legible without white text on saturated color.

rules.name: The Table Header Rule
rules.body: All table column headers are uppercase, 0.75rem, letter-spacing 0.08em, in text-muted color. This creates a consistent, scannable data grid rhythm across every page.

rules.name: The No-Border-Stack Rule
rules.body: Never stack a shadowed card on top of another shadowed card. Containment within a shadowed card is expressed via tonal surface change (subtle/muted-bg), not by adding a second shadow.

dos: Do use tonal surface steps (canvas → surface → subtle → muted-bg) for containment.
Do apply status colors only as paired text + 16% opacity background — never solid backgrounds on badges.
Do keep status badges compact (6px radius, 0.875rem, font-weight 600).
Do use mono font for IDs, tokens, timestamps, and any machine-readable data.
Do reserve accent primary for active states, focus rings, and hover borders only.
Do use the panel shadow (0 16px 42px) for cards and elevated containers.
Do keep the sidebar at 260px and use vertical navigation on desktop.
Do use Space Grotesk for all headings and Manrope for body.
Do uppercase table column headers with wide letter-spacing.
donts: Don't use pastel gradients, glassmorphism, gradient text, or side-stripe borders.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Use tonal surface change instead.
Don't apply the accent primary decoratively. Its rarity is the point.
Don't use cards when a flat table row or list item suffices.
Don't stack shadowed containers. One shadow per depth layer.
Don't wrap everything in a container. Most things don't need one.
Don't add em dashes. Use commas, colons, or periods.
Don't use modals as a first solution. Exhaust inline alternatives first.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Use ease-out-quart/expo curves. No bounce.
